summary.text: Collin Docterman is the Democratic nominee for Ohio House District 90 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Justin Pizzulli.
He works as a hospice nurse aide.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Docterman said he cares for patients and supports families as a hospice nurse aide, and that he and his wife became foster parents and adopted two children.

He said his campaign priorities include fully implementing the Fair School Funding Plan, protecting teacher benefits, improving health outcomes through Medicaid and local health departments, and returning to single-subject bills and ending legislating through the budget.
He listed AFSCME Power in Action Council 8 and the Scioto County Democratic Party among his endorsers.
